scenario: e2e/game.spec.ts real WebRTC eight clients at 32,768 ambient creatures, ninth rejection and late join
environment: 4 vCPU Linux container, Node 24.21.0, Chromium 141, nine isolated browser contexts plus local signaling

before.localReproduction: 6 of 7 guests 'Host stopped responding. Continuing solo.'; ninth 'Could not reach the host' after three attempts

diagnosis.note: A loaded host processed incoming DataChannel messages seconds late for every guest at once. Stop-and-wait guests then received nothing and their 10 s watchdog fired although the host was alive.

after.eightClientRuns: 3 of 3 isolated passes with the heartbeat; final code passed 2 consecutive full suites, 24 of 24 scenarios each

rejectedAlternatives.oneMiBRefill: 3 of 3 runs failed: the loaded host never processed the ninth client's admission, so it was not told the room was full
rejectedAlternatives.columnarFrameEncoding: Node prototype: stringify+gzip 197 ms -> 76 ms, 1,627,182 -> 1,202,736 compressed bytes. Deferred: wire format change not needed for correctness.
